text_annotations.text: Four full-duplex GTH lanes and two K26 input refclock pairs are accounted.
J2 models K26 SOM240_2 PL GTH bank224; confirm balls against current DS987.
U1 is one real x16 DDR3L symbol/footprint as a routing subset, not the 8GB BOM.
MIG pin placement, SI/PI, stackup, timing closure, and production DDR3L sourcing unresolved.
J1 is a bank boundary, not the XC7K160T FFG676 BGA pinout.

+3V3: highest SRF is 22.51 MHz — consider adding small (100pF-1nF) MLCC for >100 MHz coverage
